title: Resolve "Tutorials: Structure optimization: H2O"
body:
In this MR, part of the H2O structure optimization was moved to the new format.
It was an exercise-based tutorial with solutions at the end, but in order for things to be properly tested I moved the relevant part of the solution immediately after each exercise. 
If you know a way of making code cells collapsible and still tested, I think this would be a very nice feature to add for these solution cells.
I also added some visualization in the tutorial.

In the old tutorial, there was also a large section about calculators and sockets. This is not removed, but still under "getting started (legacy format)", now called "Use different calculators and sockets", such that it can be used when tackling #1766 and #1884.

@HannaTuerk please check if you agree with the structure and content of the moved and updated H2O structure optimization tutorial and that it matches what we discussed on Wednesday.
